image_description: A dimly lit interior view of a prison cell block, featuring two levels of cells facing each other across a central walkway. The walls are distressed concrete or plaster with peeling paint. Metal railings line the upper walkways. Barred cell doors are visible on both levels. A single light source illuminates the far end of the corridor.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a prison/correctional facility interior rather than a generic hallway or abandoned building.
To verify the structural integrity of the multi-level walkways and ensure the depth perception of the long corridor is physically valid.
To check for fusion artifacts where the thin metal bars meet the walls or floor, a common failure point in AI generation.
To assess the lighting consistency and texture realism of the distressed walls.

focus_areas: Structural connectivity of railings to walls
Perspective consistency of the vanishing point
Texture realism of peeling paint and concrete
Symmetry of the cell block layout
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection points of the metal railings. AI often fails to render thin bars connecting cleanly to solid surfaces. Also, verify if the lighting source at the end of the hall casts consistent shadows on the upper and lower levels.
